name: product-tasks
prompt: Screen: Dashboard with the "Tasks" tab active (amber underline, badge "12"); the status card is visible above the tabs with "Working hours" and "Lines busy: 4 of 5". Under the tabs a muted line "Tasks across all contacts". A three-column grid of nine task cards; each card has a small line icon, a bold action title, a two-line note written by the AI, a contact and company line, and on some cards a small deadline chip — "Due today" in amber, "Overdue" in muted red, "In 7 days" neutral. Cards: "Contact the client — Tender window opens Sep 24: prepare rates for 40 lanes, submission due Oct 3 — Maple Route Carriers — In 7 days"; "Call the client back — Asked for a call after 2 PM CT with a reefer quote — Lone Star Haulers — Due today"; "Join the chat — Wants a manager to confirm pickup windows — Prairie Line Logistics"; "Call the client back — Agreed on Tuesday 10:30 AM CT, send the updated rate sheet first — Great Lakes Freight Co."; "Contact the client — Q4 dedicated capacity RFP, 12 trucks, due in 10 days — Northstar Grocers"; "Call the client back — Tender documents were not submitted yesterday — Summit Auto Parts — Overdue"; "Contact the client — New lane Toronto → Montreal, 8 loads a month — Cascade Paper Mills"; "Join the chat — Asks for proof of insurance before booking — Blue Ridge Beverages — Due today"; "Call the client back — Decision maker returns Monday — Pacific Coast Produce". Footer "1–9 of 12". Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
